hw_timestamp_interface.description: Network interface name (e.g., 'eth0') or 'all' to enable hardware timestamping on all interfaces.

hw_timestamp_minpoll.description: Minimum polling interval (log2 seconds) for hardware timestamping checks. Increase if timestamping failures occur (e.g., 7 = 128s).

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers to synchronize with. Include optional metadata for clarity.

host.description: NTP server hostname or IP address.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the server (e.g., 'primary-ntp').

prefer.description: Mark this server as preferred (used more heavily by chronyd during selection).

key.description: Optional NTP authentication key ID (must be defined in /etc/chrony/chrony.keys).

ntp_pool.description: Optional NTP pool domain (e.g., 'pool.ntp.org') to use as fallback sources.

local_reference_enable.description: Enable local reference clock (PHC) as a fallback time source when external servers are unavailable.

debug_logging.description: Enable detailed logging (measurements, statistics, tracking) for troubleshooting hardware timestamping.

bind_interface.description: Optional specific network interface (e.g., 'eth0') to bind the NTP service to. Required when hardware timestamping is interface-specific.
